reviews.headline: The best pads I've ever tried.
reviews.comment:
I used to hate pads because they just felt like wet gauze, 
but these turned out, miraculously, softest, gentlest pads with amazing results.
 I've happily gone through three packs already. 
If you look past the PDRN marketing hype and take a closer look at the rest of the ingredients, you find a fantastic, rich formula that hydrates, supports, and locks in moisture. 
I use them as a toner on regular days and as a mask when I need to look my best 
and I absolutely love them.

reviews.headline: Sensitive skin approved ☆
reviews.comment: I have a very hard time finding skin care products that wont break me out or say they're for sensitive skin but my skin doesnt agree. This stuff is chefs kiss! I dont reslly break out or get pimples, but my pores are always clogged & this leaves my skin looking plump, refreshed, smooth & so clean. No scent, very gentle on the skin while still exfoliating. 10/10
